task:
Create an Ingress for two services in namespace 'default':

  1. Create Deployment 'api-app' (image: nginx:1.21) and Service 'api-svc' on port 8080 (targetPort 80)

  2. Create Deployment 'web-app' (image: nginx:1.21) and Service 'web-svc' on port 80

  3. Create Ingress 'app-ingress' with:
     - ingressClassName: nginx
     - Host: example.com
     - /api  (Prefix) → api-svc:8080
     - /     (Prefix) → web-svc:80

  4. Verify: kubectl describe ingress app-ingress
hints: kubectl create ingress has a --rule flag: host/path=service:port
detailed_hints: kubectl create deploy api-app --image=nginx:1.21 && kubectl expose deploy api-app --name=api-svc --port=8080 --target-port=80
kubectl create deploy web-app --image=nginx:1.21 && kubectl expose deploy web-app --name=web-svc --port=80
